Messages.Author: badger
Messages.Body:
Dear LSJ:

Can a minion with multiple strikes, use the same strike card for each of
those strikes?

Can a minion keep gaining extra strikes using the same card?

When do those additional strike cards have to be played? At beginning
round? After first strike resolved? Any time?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <357496B5...@buffnet.net>, badger <bad...@buffnet.net> wrote:
> Can a minion with multiple strikes, use the same strike card for each of
> those strikes?

Not the same copy of a strike card, but otherwise, yes.
You could play three Undead Strengths for your three strikes in
a round if you play superior Blur, for example.

> Can a minion keep gaining extra strikes using the same card?

One per round, yes. (You cannot gain additional strikes more than
once in a given round).

> When do those additional strike cards have to be played? At beginning
> round? After first strike resolved? Any time?

After the first (initial) strikes are resolved.
